test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 22,100 was divided between Timir and Monali in such a way that if both invested their shares at 10% compound interest per annum, the amount payable on maturity to Monali after 18 years would be the same as the amount payable on maturity to Timir after 20 years. What was the share of Monali in the initial sum?
solution:
Given:

Total amount = Rs. 22,100

Rate of interest = 10% per annum

The amount payable on maturity to Monali after 18 years would be the same as the amount payable on maturity to Timir after 20 years.

Concept used:

Compound interest, CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the share of Monali and Timir be Q and (22100 - Q) respectively.

Amount payable in case of Monali

⇒ Q(1 + 10 over 100)¹⁸

Amount payable in case of Timir

⇒ (22100 - Q)(1 + 10 over 100)20

According to the question,

(22100 - Q)(1 + 10 over 100)20 = Q(1 + 10 over 100)18

⇒ (22100 - Q)(1 + 10 over 100)²⁰ ⁻ ¹⁸ = Q

⇒ (22100 - Q)(1 + 10 over 100)2 = Q

⇒ (22100 - Q) × 1.21 = Q

⇒ 26741 - 1.21Q = Q

⇒ 2.21Q = 26741

⇒ Q = 26741/2.21

⇒ Q = 12100

∴ The initial share of Monali was Rs. 12,100.
